types.name: Ideas and assumptions
types.description: Asks what ANOVA tests, who developed it, which statistic it uses, or its assumptions.

types.name: Degrees of freedom
types.description: Gives the number of groups and observations in a one-way layout and asks for between, within or total degrees of freedom.

types.name: Sums of squares
types.description: Gives some sums of squares (or totals) and asks for the missing one.

types.name: Mean squares and the F-ratio
types.description: Gives sums of squares with the number of groups and observations and asks for mean squares or the F-ratio.

types.name: One-way ANOVA from raw data
types.description: Lists the observations in each group and asks for SSB, SSW or the F-ratio.

types.name: Two-way ANOVA
types.description: Mentions rows and columns (blocks and treatments) and asks for degrees of freedom, mean squares or F in a two-way table.
